title: feat(c9q8): cov9>0 is not Q8; positivity implies Q8
science: Bounded_theorem note, not a probe cell. 32 F_cut maps on 220 nine-site seeds: cov9>0 not equivalent to Q8 (four Q8-true zeros, lex-first (0,1,0,0,0)) but positivity DOES imply Q8 even though the weaker Q6 implication had failed; N_pos=26, N_Q8=30, N_both=26; the unique Q6-false positive (0,1,0,0,1) with cov9=4 is Q8-true, which is what repairs the implication.
